blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Senate has “the sole power to try and decide all cases of impeachment,” four retired Supreme Court justices stressed that constitutional provision as they gave their legal opinions as amici curiae on Wednesday, the 26th day of Vice President Sara Duterte’s impeachment trial. In a prosecution statement, former Rep. Robert Ace Barbers, House impeachment panel adviser and spokesperson, highlighted the point in a post-trial news briefing, saying that it gave the Senate impeachment court the authority to adopt its own rules and procedures during the trial.
